test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the wrong pair (Bank and related category) from following-

options.text: Punjab National Bank - Public Sector Bank
AU Bank Ltd - Small Finance Bank
Axis Bank Ltd - Private Sector Bank

solution:
The correct answer is __**Canara Bank - Payments Bank.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Canara Bank** is not a Payments Bank, it is a **Public Sector Bank.**
 
• **Public Sector Banks** are those banks in which the **government** holds a **majority stake.** 
 
• These banks are established to provide banking services to the** general public** and promote** financial inclusion. **
 
• **Payments Banks **are a new category of banks in India that were introduced by the **Reserve Bank of India in 2015.** 
 
• These banks can accept deposits up to** Rs. 1 lakh **and provide **payment and remittance** services, but cannot lend money or issue credit cards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punjab National Bank** is a **Public Sector Bank, **which is a correct category.
 
• **AU Bank Ltd** is a **Small Finance Bank,** which is a correct category.
 
 
• **Small Finance Banks** are a type of **niche banks** that were introduced by the **Reserve Bank of India **in 2015.
 
• These banks primarily cater to the needs of **small businesses, farmers,** and** low-income households.**
 
 
 
• **Axis Bank Ltd** is a** Private Sector Bank**, which is a correct category. 
 
 
• **Private Sector Banks **are those banks in which the majority of the shares are held by **private individuals or companies**.
 
• These banks are profit-driven and operate with the primary objective of **maximizing shareholder value.**
